headline: Strait of Hormuz blockade days away from crippling Taiwan's semiconductor industry amid escalating US-Iran war.
summary: The intensifying US-Iran conflict threatens a critical escalation with an imminent Strait of Hormuz blockade, which would devastate global oil markets and directly cripple Taiwan's semiconductor production by disrupting vital raw material and component shipments. This geopolitical flashpoint, coupled with an existing helium shortage impacting chip manufacturing, poses an unprecedented and widespread threat to global tech supply chains and AI infrastructure.
